manifest.name: chc5_xilinx_fw
manifest.description: Xilinx-IP colour ISP for 4-lane 12-bit MIPI CSI-2 sensors up to 5568x3672: CSI-2 receive, raw crop, black-level correction, demosaic, gamma, colour-space conversion, Bayer/RGB/YUV pixel packing, 1080p60 HDMI output and PTP camera sync; no AE/AWB statistics, no white-balance gain and no 3x3 colour correction matrix.
